class A {
    final B? b;

    A({
        this.b,
    });

    factory A.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return A(
            b: json["b"] != null ? B.fromJson(json["b"] as Map<String, dynamic>) : null,
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "b": b?.toJson(),
        };
    }
}

class B {
    final A? a;

    B({
        this.a,
    });

    factory B.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return B(
            a: json["a"] != null ? A.fromJson(json["a"] as Map<String, dynamic>) : null,
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "a": a?.toJson(),
        };
    }
}

class TreeNode {
    final List<TreeNode>? children;
    final String value;

    TreeNode({
        this.children,
        required this.value,
    });

    factory TreeNode.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return TreeNode(
            children: (json["children"] as List<dynamic>?)?.map((e) => TreeNode.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList(),
            value: json["value"] as String,
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "children": children?.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList(),
            "value": value,
        };
    }
}
